question_stem:
The light has a single frequency of 7.06 × 10^{14} Hz. The diffraction grating has 650 lines per
millimetre.
Calculate the number of orders of diffracted light produced by the grating. Do not include the
zero order.
Show your working.
number = [3]
[3]
question_stem_latex:
The light has a single frequency of $7.06 \times 10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$. The diffraction grating has 650 lines per
millimetre.
Calculate the number of orders of diffracted light produced by the grating. Do not include the
zero order.
Show your working.
$number = [3]$

parts.question_text:
A second source S_{2} is used in place of S_{1}. The light from S_{2} has a single frequency lower
than that of the light from S_{1}.
State and explain whether more orders are seen with the light from S_{2}.
